description: The file defines a state management class 'NewsAppState' for a Flutter news application, handling data fetching, error states, and local persistence.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the state of news data, including fetching, caching, error handling, and persistence.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the application state by loading saved news and fetching categories from the network or mock data on failure.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns a list of news articles for a specific category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns a list of top headlines, limited by a constant count.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns a list of articles in the general category after the top headlines.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Fetches and updates news articles for a specific category, handling errors and fallback to mock data if needed.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches news articles for a category from the network repository.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Populates all categories with mock data, typically used during error fallback.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with the given headline is saved locally.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves an article to local database and updates the saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a saved article based on the headline.
